```julia
# --- JACC.jl unified GPU/CPU computation ---
@jacc function jacc_distance_matrix_kernel(output, coords1, coords2, n_atoms)
    i = @jacc_index_global_i
    j = @jacc_index_global_j
    
    if i <= n_atoms && j <= n_atoms
        diff_x = coords1[i, 1] - coords2[j, 1]
        diff_y = coords1[i, 2] - coords2[j, 2] 
        diff_z = coords1[i, 3] - coords2[j, 3]
        output[i, j] = sqrt(diff_x^2 + diff_y^2 + diff_z^2)
    end
end

function ultra_accelerated_distance_matrix(coords::AbstractMatrix)
    @debug "Computing distance matrix with JACC.jl on any hardware"
    n_atoms = size(coords, 1)
    dist_matrix = zeros(Float32, n_atoms, n_atoms)
    
    @jacc_launch jacc_distance_matrix_kernel(dist_matrix, coords, coords, n_atoms) 
        ndrange=(n_atoms, n_atoms)
    
    return dist_matrix
end
```

### **3. SIMD optimalizált függvény (a compute_properties_simd helyett, sor 2800 körül):**

```julia
# --- LoopVectorization.jl brutális gyorsítás ---
function compute_properties_turbo(coords::AbstractMatrix{Float32})
    @info "Computing properties with @turbo mega-optimization"
    n_atoms = size(coords, 1)
    if n_atoms == 0 return Dict("radius_of_gyration" => 0.0f0) end
    
    # Center of mass with @turbo
    center_x = center_y = center_z = 0.0f0
    @turbo for i in 1:n_atoms
        center_x += coords[i,1]
        center_y += coords[i,2] 
        center_z += coords[i,3]
    end
    center_x /= n_atoms
    center_y /= n_atoms
    center_z /= n_atoms
    
    # Radius of gyration with @turbo
    sum_sq_dist = 0.0f0
    @turbo for i in 1:n_atoms
        dx = coords[i,1] - center_x
        dy = coords[i,2] - center_y
        dz = coords[i,3] - center_z
        sum_sq_dist += dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz
    end
    
    radius_of_gyration = sqrt(sum_sq_dist / n_atoms)
    return Dict("radius_of_gyration" => radius_of_gyration)
end
```
